notes: Required change 1 is closed. At realizations.py:733-737 the guard builds effective_settings from every active opensiddur:variant declaration in the document plus the defaults for the target. It raises when the printing option's feature is true at any j:transclude outside the attested caller's file and project, whatever the target, root, alias or range. test_root_alias_or_range_cannot_bypass_printing_guard covers a transclusion of the home root with map_root true, and a targetEnd range, each with an explicit true selection. Both now fail.

The guard is deliberately over-broad: a declaration that sets the feature true, followed by any transclusion in a non-caller generated document, is rejected even if that transclusion never reaches the Modim home. A wording variant elsewhere that reuses the same condition URN would also be rejected. Both cases fail closed, which is acceptable for this scope.

Required change 2 is closed. canonical_printings.py:157-163 requires every fragment's scan to match s[1-9][0-9]* and the scans to strictly increase across all fragments of the occurrence, not just at the declared boundary. test_boundary_must_advance_to_a_later_scan rejects both the same scan (s346) and an earlier scan (s345).

bindings(), apply() (canonical_printings.py:216-217) and the guard (realizations.py:700-702) now all read only opensiddur:variant features from wording_selection and declarations. _selected_prefix receives the same settings, so the previous inconsistency is gone.

The runtime proof looks sound. compile-modim-printing-proof.py builds a real rosh_hashanah root that externally transcludes the kohanim_appendix_modim caller URN, syncs the actual draft project into a ReferenceDatabase and compiles it with CompilerProcessor. It asserts exactly one n347 pb, words identical to the caller's space-joined source fragments, SCAN_LINK true after mark_scan_links, and a tail starting with נִסֶּֽיךָ. Compiling rh_hodaah asserts there is no n347 marker. This also covers the earlier test gap about scan links with the real path shape (shared rosh_hashanah prefix, caller reached through its siddur URN, bare first break).

Bypassing the registry with unchecked_registry is limited to the compile step, and the stated reason (candidate wording URNs not yet promoted) is consistent with the remaining checks still going through the actual refdb, compiler, conditional, range and scan-link pipeline.
limitations: This was a read-only review. I did not run the tests or the proof script. I relied on canonical-printings-final-remedies-tests.log (205 passed, 201 subtests) and actual-modim-printing-proof.json, and did not open proof_index.xml.compiled.xml or rh_hodaah.xml.compiled.xml.

In the proof JSON, appendix_scan_link_correct for rh_hodaah is hard-coded to true by the script. It is vacuous there, because that file has no marker; the meaningful check for that file is the asserted absence of the n347 marker.
I did not confirm that draft-kohanim-project was regenerated by exactly the code in canonical-printings-approval.diff, rather than by an earlier build.

The guard catches only an explicit or defaulted true value in documents generated in this build. A transclusion whose target is not mapped by groups and that carries no declaration leaves the feature undecided rather than false. How the exporter renders such an undecided option, especially in the electronic destination, is outside this importer check. The same applies to hand-written books, other projects' structure files and settings files, which are out of scope as stated.
Source fidelity, batch acceptance and the correctness of the readings data remain out of scope.
